spec.description:
Autex Surface Finishes Cube is a lightweight, semi-rigid acoustic panel
featuring high-definition digital UV printing of natural timber, stone,
concrete, and textile textures onto Cube polyester felt. Engineered without the
cost, weight, or fire hazards of real timber or masonry, Surface Finishes Cube
delivers an authentic architectural look while absorbing unwanted sound
(NRC 0.45 - 0.80). Available in 12mm and 24mm thicknesses, it achieves NCC
Group 1 fire compliance and carbon-neutral certification.
features:
High-definition digital printing of premium timber grains, stone, and
architectural textures

Printed with safe, water-based, UV-cured ink with zero
negative impact on acoustic absorption

Semi-rigid 100% polyester Cube base
with solid colour core

Constructed from 100% polyester fibre containing a
minimum of 80% recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705
- 2003 and AS 5637.1

Lightweight and seismic-safe alternative to solid wood,
stone, or precast panels

Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party
verified EPD

Moisture and mould resistant with an ASTM G21-15 Growth Rating
of 0

Compatible with Direct-fix, SpinFix, and Peel and Stick installation
methods

install: Ensure substrate is plumb, flat, clean, and dry
Acclimatise panels in the space for at least 24 hours prior to installation

Inspect woodgrain or stone pattern direction and plan panel alignment across
the wall

Apply recommended high-grab MS polymer or contact adhesive evenly to
the panel back

Alternatively, install using Autex SpinFix mounting clips or
Peel and Stick backing

Position panel onto substrate, butt joins neatly
together, and roll firmly with a pressure roller

Trim perimeter edges
carefully from the face using a straight edge and sharp utility knife on the
offcut side
selection_checklist:
Select finish from Acoustic Timber
woodgrains (Oak, Birch, Walnut, etc.) or Surface Finishes stone/concrete
collections

Select panel thickness (12mm for standard wall panelling or 24mm
for higher acoustic absorption)

Confirm panel dimensions
(1220x2440mm, 1220x2740mm, or custom up to 3000mm)

Specify installation
method (adhesive direct-fix, SpinFix, or Peel and Stick)

Verify substrate
framing supports chosen fixing system
accessories: Autex Edging Solutions (Type B for 12mm, Type C for 24mm)
High-grab MS polymer or contact adhesive
limitations:
Recommended for non-contact areas as printed surface may show
scuff marks under heavy impact

Indoor use only; avoid wet areas or direct
water exposure

Do not use in high-impact sports halls without protective
screening

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Surface Finishes
Cube combines semi-rigid 12mm or 24mm Cube polyester felt with high-definition
digital UV printing of premium timber grains, stone, and concrete textures.
Achieving sound absorption ratings from NRC 0.45 to 0.80, it replicates heavy,
reverberant building materials without structural weight, timber flammability,
or warping risks. Group 1 fire compliant under AS ISO 9705 and containing at
least 80% recycled PET, it provides a lightweight, carbon-neutral architectural
wall and ceiling finish for commercial, civic, and hospitality spaces.
